me1.ar: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَحْدَهُ، وَالصَّلاَةُ وَالسَّلاَمُ عَلَى مَنْ لاَ نَبِيَّ بَعْدَهُ
me1.tr: All praise is due to Allah alone, and peace and blessings be upon him after whom there is no other Prophet.
me1.tl: Alḥamdulillahi waḥdah waṣ-ṣalatu was-salam `alā man lā nabiyya ba`dah.
me1.v: The recommendation to begin supplication with praise to Allah the Exalted and extolling Him, followed by prayers upon the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
me1.va: استحباب ابتداء الدعاء بالحمد لله -تعالى- والثناء، ثم الصلاة على رسول الله ﷺ
me1.s: Anas (RA) said that he heard the Prophet (ﷺ) say: "That I sit with people remembering Almighty Allah from the morning (Fajr) prayer until sunrise is more beloved to me than freeing four slaves from among the Children of Isma'il. That I sit with people remembering Allah from the afternoon ('Asr) prayer, until the sun sets, is more beloved to me than freeing four slaves from among the Children of Isma'il."This was reported by Abu Dawud (No. 3667). Al-Albani graded it good in Sahih Abu Dawud 2/698.
me1.sa: عن أنس يرفعه: ((لأن أقعد مع قوم يذكرون اللَّه تعالى من صلاة الغداة حتى تطلع الشمس أحبُّ إليَّ من أن أُعتق أربعة من ولد إسماعيل، ولأن أقعد مع قوم يذكرون اللَّه من صلاة العصر إلى أن تغرب الشمس أحبّ إليَّ من أن أعتق أربعة)). أبو داود، برقم 3667، وحسنه الألباني، في صحيح أبي داود، 2/698 .

me2.ar: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ ﴿اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لاَ تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلاَ نَوْمٌ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الأَرْضِ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلاَ يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلاَّ بِمَا شَاء وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَلاَ يَؤُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ﴾
me2.tr: Allah! There is none worthy of worship but He, the Ever-Living, the One Who sustains and protects all that exists. Neither slumber nor sleep overtakes Him. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is he that can intercede with Him except with His Permission? He knows what happens to them in this world, and what will happen to them in the Hereafter. And they will never encompass anything of His Knowledge except that which He wills. His Throne extends over the heavens and the earth, and He feels no fatigue in guarding and preserving them. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.
me2.tl:
(A`ūdhu billāhi min ash-shaytāni 'r-rajīm)
Allāhu lā ilāha illā huwa ‘l-Ḥayyul-Qayyūm,
lā ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa lā nawm,
lahu mā fis-samāwāti wa māfil-arḍ,
man dhal-ladhī yashfa`u `indahu illā bi'idhnih,
ya`lamu mā bayna aydīhim wa mā khalfahum,
wa lā yuḥīṭūna bishay'im-min `ilmihi illā bimā shā',
wasi`a kursiyyuhus-samāwāti wal-arḍ,
wa lā ya'ūduhu hifẓuhumā,
wa huwal-`Aliyyu‘l-`Aẓīm.
me2.v: (Ayat al-Kursi; Al-Qur'an 2:255) Whoever says this when he rises in the morning will be protected from jinns until he retires in the evening, and whoever says it when retiring in the evening will be protected from them until he rises in the morning.
me2.va: [سورة البقرة، الآية: 255] من قالها حين يصبح أُجير من الجن حتى يمسي، ومن قالها حين يمسي أُجير منهم حتى يصبح
me2.s: It was reported by Al-Hakim 1 / 562, Al-Albani graded it as authentic in Sahihut-Targhib wat-Tarhib 1/273, and traces it to An-Nasa'i and At-Tabarani. He says that At-Tabarani's chain of transmission is reliable (Jayyid).
me2.sa: أخرجه الحاكم، 1/562، وصححه الألباني في صحيح الترغيب والترهيب، 1/273، وعزاه إلى النسائي، والطبراني، وقال: ((إسناد الطبراني جيد)).

me3.ar: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ ﴿آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِن رَّبِّهِ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ كُلٌّ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَمَلآئِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ لاَ نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِّن رُّسُلِهِ وَقَالُواْ سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ* لاَ يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْساً إِلاَّ وُسْعَهَا لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ رَبَّنَا لاَ تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِن نَّسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا رَبَّنَا وَلاَ تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْراً كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا رَبَّنَا وَلاَ تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لاَ طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَآ أَنتَ مَوْلاَنَا فَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ﴾.
me3.tr: (285) The Messenger has believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord, and [so have] the believers. All of them have believed in Allah and His angels and His books and His messengers, [saying], We make no distinction between any of His messengers. And they say, We hear and we obey. [We seek] Your forgiveness, our Lord, and to You is the [final] destination. (286) Allah does not charge a soul except [with that within] its capacity. It will have [the consequence of] what [good] it has gained, and it will bear [the consequence of] what [evil] it has earned. Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we have forgotten or erred. Our Lord, and lay not upon us a burden like that which You laid upon those before us. Our Lord, and burden us not with that which we have no ability to bear. And pardon us; and forgive us; and have mercy upon us. You are our protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people.
me3.tl:
Aamanar-Rasoolu bimaaa unzila ilaihi mir-Rabbihee walmu'minoon; kullun aamana billaahi wa Malaaa'ikathihee wa Kutubhihee wa Rusulihee laa nufarriqu baina ahadim-mir-Rusulih wa qaaloo sami'naa wa ata'naa ghufraanaka Rabbanaa wa ilaikal-maseer (285)
Laa yukalliful-laahu nafsan illaa wus'ahaa; lahaa maa kasabat wa 'alaihaa maktasabat; Rabbanaa laa tu'aakhiznaaa in naseenaaa aw akhtaanaa; Rabbanaa wa laa tahmil-'alainaaa isran kamaa hamaltahoo 'alal-lazeena min qablinaa; Rabbanaa wa laa tuhammilnaa maa laa taaqata lanaa bih; wa'fu 'annaa waghfir lanaa warhamnaa; Anta mawlaanaa fansurnaa 'alal qawmil kaafireen (286)
me3.v: Al-Baqarah 2:285-6. These two Verses will be sufficient for anyone who recites them at night before sleeping.
me3.va: من قرأ آيتين من آخر سورة البقرة في ليلة كفتاه.
me3.s: It was narrated by Al-Bukhari, No. 4008, and Muslim, No. 807.

me4.ar: قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ، ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ، لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ، وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌۢ
me4.tr: (1) Say, He is Allah, [who is] One, (2) Allah, the Eternal Refuge.(3) He neither begets nor is born,(4) Nor is there to Him any equivalent.
me4.tl: Bismillaahir Rahmaanir Raheem "Qul huwal laahu ahad (1) Allah hus-samad (2) Lam yalid wa lam yoolad (3) Wa lam yakul-lahoo kufuwan ahad (4)
me4.v: Al-Ikhlas 112:1-4, Al-Falaq 113:1-5, An-Nas 114:1-6. Whoever recites these three times in the morning and in the evening, they will suffice him (as a protection) against everything.
me4.va: من قالها ثلاث مرات حين يصبح وحين يمسي كفته من كل شيء
me4.s: The Hadith was reported by Abu Dawud 4/322, and At-Tirmidhi 5/567. See Al-Albani's Sahih At-Tirmidhi 3/182.
me4.sa: أخرجه أبو داود، 4/ 322، برقم 5082، والترمذي، 5/ 567، برقم 3575، وانظر: صحيح الترمذي، 3/182.

me5.ar: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ، مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ، وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ، وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّٰثَٰتِ فِى ٱلْعُقَدِ، وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
me5.tr: (1) Say, I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak (2) From the evil of that which He created (3) And from the evil of darkness when it settles (4) And from the evil of the blowers in knots (5) And from the evil of an envier when he envies.
me5.tl: Bismillaahir Rahmaanir Raheem "Qul a'oozu bi rabbil-falaq (1) Min sharri maa khalaq (2) Wa min sharri ghaasiqin izaa waqab (3) Wa min sharrin-naffaa-taati fil 'uqad (4) Wa min sharri haasidin izaa hasad (5)
me5.v: Al-Ikhlas 112:1-4, Al-Falaq 113:1-5, An-Nas 114:1-6. Whoever recites these three times in the morning and in the evening, they will suffice him (as a protection) against everything.
me5.va: من قالها ثلاث مرات حين يصبح وحين يمسي كفته من كل شيء
me5.s: The Hadith was reported by Abu Dawud 4/322, and At-Tirmidhi 5/567. See Al-Albani's Sahih At-Tirmidhi 3/182.
me5.sa: أخرجه أبو داود، 4/ 322، برقم 5082، والترمذي، 5/ 567، برقم 3575، وانظر: صحيح الترمذي، 3/182.

me6.ar: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ، مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ، إِلَٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ، مِن شَرِّ ٱلْوَسْوَاسِ ٱلْخَنَّاسِ، ٱلَّذِى يُوَسْوِسُ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ، مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ
me6.tr: (1) Say, I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind (2) The Sovereign of mankind (3) The God of mankind (4) From the evil of the retreating whisperer (5) Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind (6) From among the jinn and mankind.
me6.tl:
Bismillaahir Rahmaanir Raheem "Qul a'oozu birabbin naas (1)
Malikin naas (2)
Ilaahin naas (3)
Min sharril waswaasil khannaas (4)
Allazee yuwaswisu fee sudoorin naas (5)
Minal jinnati wannaas (6)
me6.v: Al-Ikhlas 112:1-4, Al-Falaq 113:1-5, An-Nas 114:1-6. Whoever recites these three times in the morning and in the evening, they will suffice him (as a protection) against everything.
me6.va: من قالها ثلاث مرات حين يصبح وحين يمسي كفته من كل شيء
me6.s: The Hadith was reported by Abu Dawud 4/322, and At-Tirmidhi 5/567. See Al-Albani's Sahih At-Tirmidhi 3/182.
me6.sa: أخرجه أبو داود، 4/ 322، برقم 5082، والترمذي، 5/ 567، برقم 3575، وانظر: صحيح الترمذي، 3/182.

me7.ar: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْملْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْملْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَخَيرَ مَا بَعْدَهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ
me7.tr: We have reached the morning and at this very time unto Allah belongs all sovereignty, and all praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this day and the good of what follows it and I take refuge in You from the evil of this day and the evil of what follows it. My Lord, I take refuge in You from laziness and senility. My Lord, I take refuge in You from torment in the Fire and punishment in the grave.
me7.tl: Asbahna wa-asbahal-mulku lillah, walhamdu lillah, la ilaha illal-lah, wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeer, rabbi as-aluka khayra ma fee hathal-yawm, wakhayra ma baAAdahu, wa-aAAoothu bika min sharri hathal-yawm, washarri ma baAAdahu, rabbi aAAoothu bika minal-kasal, wasoo-il kibar, rabbi aAAoothu bika min AAathabin fin-nar, waAAathabin fil-qabr.

me8.ar: أمسينا وأمسى الملك للَّه، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، رب أسألك خير ما في هذه الليلة، وخير ما بعدها، وأعوذ بك من شر ما في هذه الليلة، وشر ما بعدها، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ
me8.tr: We have reached the evening and at this very time unto Allah belongs all sovereignty, and all praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this night and the good of what follows it and I take refuge in You from the evil of this night and the evil of what follows it. My Lord, I take refuge in You from laziness and senility. My Lord, I take refuge in You from torment in the Fire and punishment in the grave.
me8.tl: Amsayna wa-amsal-mulku lillah, walhamdu lillah, la ilaha illal-lah, wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeer, rabbi as-aluka khayra ma fee hathihil-laylah, wakhayra ma baAAdaha, wa-aAAoothu bika min sharri hathihil-laylah, washarri ma baAAdaha, rabbi aAAoothu bika minal-kasal, wasoo-il kibar, rabbi aAAoothu bika min AAathabin fin-nar, waAAathabin fil-qabr.

me9.ar: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
me9.tr: O Allah, by Your leave we have reached the morning and by Your leave we have reached the evening, by Your leave we live and die and unto You is our resurrection
me9.tl: Allahumma bika asbahna, wabika amsayna, wabika nahya, wabika namootu wa-ilaykan-nushoor.
me9.s: Al-Tirmidhi, 5/466, No. 3391, and see: Sahih Al-Tirmidhi 3/142.

me10.ar: اللَّهمَّ بِكَ أمسَينا وبِكَ أصبَحنا وبِكَ نَحيا وبِكَ نموتُ، وإليكَ المصيرُ
me10.tr: O Allah, by Your leave we have reached the evening and by Your leave we have reached the morning, by Your leave we live and die and unto You is our return.
me10.tl: Allahumma bika amsayna, wabika asbahna, wabika nahya, wabika namootu wa-ilaykal-maseer.
me10.s: Al-Tirmidhi, 5/466, No. 3391, and see: Sahih Al-Tirmidhi 3/142.

me11.ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
me11.tr: O Allah, You are my Lord, none has the right to be worshipped except You, You created me and I am Your servant and I abide to Your covenant and promise as best I can, I take refuge in You from the evil of which I have committed. I acknowledge Your favour upon me and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for verily none can forgive sin except You.
me11.tl: Allahumma anta rabbee la ilaha illa ant, khalaqtanee wa-ana AAabduk, wa-ana AAala AAahdika wawaAAdika mas-tataAAt, aAAoothu bika min sharri ma sanaAAt, aboo-o laka biniAAmatika AAalay, wa-aboo-o bithanbee, faghfir lee fa-innahu la yaghfiruth-thunooba illa ant.
me11.v: Whoever recites this with conviction in the evening and dies during that night shall enter Paradise, and whoever recites it with conviction in the morning and dies during that day shall enter Paradise
me11.va: وَمَنْ قَالَهَا مِنَ النَّهَارِ مُوقِنًا بِهَا، فَمَاتَ مِنْ يَوْمِهِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُمْسِيَ، فَهُوَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ، وَمَنْ قَالَهَا مِنَ اللَّيْلِ وَهُوَ مُوقِنٌ بِهَا، فَمَاتَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُصْبِحَ، فَهُوَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ

me12.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَصْبَحْتُ أُشْهِدُكَ، وَأُشْهِدُ حَمَلَةَ عَرْشِكَ، وَمَلاَئِكَتَكَ، وَجَمِيعَ خَلْقِكَ، أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ
me12.tr: O Allah, verily I have reached the morning and call on You, the bearers of Your throne, Your angels, and all of Your creation to witness that You are Allah, none has the right to be worshipped except You, alone, without partner, and that Muhammad is Your Servant and Messenger.
me12.tl: Allahumma innee asbahtu oshhiduka, wa-osshidu hamalata AAarshika, wamala-ikatika, wajameeAAa khalqika, annaka antal-lahu la ilaha illa ant, wahdaka la shareeka lak, wa-anna Muhammadan AAabduka warasooluka.
me12.v: Allah will spare whoever says this four times in the morning or evening from the fire of Hell.
me12.va: من قالها حين يصبح، أو يمسي أربع مرات، أعتقه اللَّه من النار
me12.s: It was narrated by Abu Dawood, 4/317, No. 5069, and by Al-Bukhari in Al-Adab Al-Mufrad, No. 1201, and by Al-Nasa'i in 'Amal Al-Yawm wal-Laylah, No. 9, and by Ibn Al-Sunni, No. 70. Sheikh Ibn Baz classified the isnad of Al-Nasa'i and Abu Dawood as hasan in Tuhfat Al-Akhyar, p. 23.
me12.sa: أخرجه أبو داود، 4/ 317، برقم 5069، والبخاري في الأدب المفرد، برقم 1201، والنسائي في عمل اليوم والليلة، برقم 9، وابن السني، برقم 70، وحسّن سماحة الشيخ ابن باز ‘ إسناد النسائي، وأبي داود، في تحفة الأخيار، ص23.

me13.ar: اللَّهم إني أمسيت أُشْهِدُكَ، وَأُشْهِدُ حَمَلَةَ عَرْشِكَ، وَمَلاَئِكَتَكَ، وَجَمِيعَ خَلْقِكَ، أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ
me13.tr: O Allah, verily I have reached the evening and call on You, the bearers of Your throne, Your angels, and all of Your creation to witness that You are Allah, none has the right to be worshipped except You, alone, without partner, and that Muhammad is Your Servant and Messenger.
me13.tl: Allahumma innee amsaytu oshhiduka, wa-osshidu hamalata AAarshika, wamala-ikatika, wajameeAAa khalqika, annaka antal-lahu la ilaha illa ant, wahdaka la shareeka lak, wa-anna Muhammadan AAabduka warasooluka.
me13.v: Allah will spare whoever says this four times in the morning or evening from the fire of Hell.
me13.va: من قالها حين يصبح، أو يمسي أربع مرات، أعتقه اللَّه من النار
me13.s: It was narrated by Abu Dawood, 4/317, No. 5069, and by Al-Bukhari in Al-Adab Al-Mufrad, No. 1201, and by Al-Nasa'i in 'Amal Al-Yawm wal-Laylah, No. 9, and by Ibn Al-Sunni, No. 70. Sheikh Ibn Baz classified the isnad of Al-Nasa'i and Abu Dawood as hasan in Tuhfat Al-Akhyar, p. 23.
me13.sa: أخرجه أبو داود، 4/ 317، برقم 5069، والبخاري في الأدب المفرد، برقم 1201، والنسائي في عمل اليوم والليلة، برقم 9، وابن السني، برقم 70، وحسّن سماحة الشيخ ابن باز ‘ إسناد النسائي، وأبي داود، في تحفة الأخيار، ص23.

me14.ar: اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَصْبَحَ بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ، فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ
me14.tr: O Allah, what blessing I or any of Your creation have risen upon is from You alone, without partner. So for You is all praise and unto You all thanks.
me14.tl: Allahumma ma asbaha bee min niAAmatin, aw bi-ahadin min khalqika, faminka wahdaka la shareeka lak, falakal-hamdu walakash-shukr.
me14.v: Whoever recites this in the morning, has completed his obligation to thank Allah for that day; and whoever says it in the evening, has completed his obligation for that night.
me14.va: من قالها حين يصبح فقد أدَّى شكر يومه، ومن قالها حين يمسي فقد أدَّى شكر ليلته
me14.s: It was narrated by Abu Dawood, 4/318, No. 5073, and by Al-Nasa'i in 'Amal Al-Yawm wal-Laylah, No. 7, and by Ibn Al-Sunni, No. 41, and by Ibn Hibban in Mawarid, No. 2361. Sheikh Ibn Baz classified the isnad as hasan in Tuhfat Al-Akhyar, p. 24.
me14.sa: أخرجه أبو داود، 4/ 318، برقم 5073، والنسائي في عمل اليوم والليلة، برقم 7، وابن السني، برقم 41، وابن حبان، ((موارد)) برقم 2361، وحسّن ابن باز ‘ إسناده في تحفة الأخيار، ص24.

me15.ar: اللَّهم ما أمسى بي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ، فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ
me15.tr: O Allah, what blessing I or any of Your creation have reached the evening upon is from You alone, without partner. So for You is all praise and unto You all thanks
me15.tl: Allahumma ma amsa bee min niAAmatin, aw bi-ahadin min khalqika, faminka wahdaka la shareeka lak, falakal-hamdu walakash-shukr.
me15.v: Whoever recites this in the morning, has completed his obligation to thank Allah for that day; and whoever says it in the evening, has completed his obligation for that night.
me15.va: من قالها حين يصبح فقد أدَّى شكر يومه، ومن قالها حين يمسي فقد أدَّى شكر ليلته
me15.s: It was narrated by Abu Dawood, 4/318, No. 5073, and by Al-Nasa'i in 'Amal Al-Yawm wal-Laylah, No. 7, and by Ibn Al-Sunni, No. 41, and by Ibn Hibban in Mawarid, No. 2361. Sheikh Ibn Baz classified the isnad as hasan in Tuhfat Al-Akhyar, p. 24.
me15.sa: أخرجه أبو داود، 4/ 318، برقم 5073، والنسائي في عمل اليوم والليلة، برقم 7، وابن السني، برقم 41، وابن حبان، ((موارد)) برقم 2361، وحسّن ابن باز ‘ إسناده في تحفة الأخيار، ص24.

me16.ar: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ. اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكُفْرِ، وَالفَقْرِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ القَبْرِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
me16.tr: (O Allah, grant my body health, O Allah, grant my hearing health, O Allah, grant my sight health. None has the right to be worshipped except You.) (O Allah, I take refuge with You from disbelief and poverty, and I take refuge with You from the punishment of the grave. None has the right to be worshipped except You.)
me16.tl: (Allahumma AAafinee fee badanee, allahumma AAafinee fee samAAee, allahumma AAafinee fee basaree, la ilaha illa ant.) (Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika minal-kufr, walfaqr, wa-aAAoothu bika min AAathabil-qabr, la ilaha illa ant.)
me16.s: Abu Dawud 4/324, Ahmad 5/42, An-Nasa'i, 'Amalul-Yawm wal-Laylah (No. 22), Ibn As-Sunni (No. 69), Al-Bukhari Al-'Adab Al-Mufrad. Its chain of transmission is good (Hasan), Ibn Baz, p. 26.
me16.sa: أبو داود، 4/ 324، برقم 5090، وأحمد، 5/ 42، برقم 20430، والنسائي في عمل اليوم والليلة، برقم 22، وابن السني، برقم 69، والبخاري في الأدب المفرد، برقم 701، وحسّن العلامة ابن باز ‘ إسناده في تحفة الأخيار، ص26.

me17.ar: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ عَلَيهِ تَوَكَّلتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
me17.tr: Allah is Sufficient for me, none has the right to be worshipped except Him, upon Him I rely and He is Lord of the exalted throne.
me17.tl: Hasbiyal-lahu la ilaha illa huwa, AAalayhi tawakkalt, wahuwa rabbul-AAarshil-AAatheem
me17.v: Allah will grant whoever recites this seven times in the morning or evening whatever he desires from this world or the next
me17.va: من قالها حين يصبح وحين يمسي سبع مرات كفاه اللَّه ما أهمّه من أمر الدنيا والآخرة
me17.s: It was narrated by Ibn As-Sunni, No. 71, attributed directly to the Prophet (Marfu'), and by Abu Dawud as a statement of a Companion (Mawquf), 4/321, No. 5081. The chain of transmission was authenticated by Shu'ayb and 'Abd al-Qadir al-Arna'ut. See: Zad Al-Ma'ad 2/376.
me17.sa: أخرجه ابن السني، برقم 71 مرفوعاً، وأبو داود موقوفاً، 4/ 321، برقم 5081، وصحّح إسناده شعيب وعبدالقادر الأرناؤوط. انظر: زاد المعاد 2/376.

me18.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ: فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي، وَمَالِي، اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي، وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي، اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَينِ يَدَيَّ، وَمِنْ خَلْفِي، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي، وَعَنْ شِمَالِي، وَمِنْ فَوْقِي، وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي
me18.tr: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in this life and the next. O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in my religious and worldly affairs, and my family and my wealth. O Allah, veil my weaknesses and set at ease my dismay. O Allah, preserve me from the front and from behind and on my right and on my left and from above, and I take refuge with You lest I be swallowed up by the earth.
me18.tl: Allahumma innee as-alukal-AAafwa walAAafiyah, fid-dunya wal-akhirah, allahumma innee as-alukal-AAafwa walAAafiyah fee deenee, wadunyaya wa-ahlee, wamalee, allahummas-tur AAawratee, wa-amin rawAAatee, allahummah-fathnee min bayni yaday, wamin khalfee, waAAan yameenee, waAAan shimalee, wamin fawqee, wa-aAAoothu biAAathamatika an oghtala min tahtee.
me18.s: Abu Dawood, No. 5074, and Ibn Majah, No. 3871. See: Sahih Ibn Majah, 2/332.
me18.sa: أبو داود، برقم 5074، وابن ماجه، برقم 3871، وانظر: صحيح ابن ماجه، 2/332.

me19.ar: اللَّهُمَّ عَالِمَ الغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ فَاطِرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطانِ وَشَرَكِهِ، وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَى نَفْسِي سُوءاً، أَوْ أَجُرَّهُ إِلَى مُسْلِمٍ
me19.tr: (O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the seen, Creator of the heavens and the Earth, Lord and Sovereign of all things, I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except You. I take refuge in You from the evil of my soul and from the evil and shirk of the devil, and from committing wrong against my soul or bringing such upon another Muslim.)(shirk: to associate others with Allah in those things which are specific to Him. This can occur in (1) belief, e.g. to believe that other than Allah has the power to benefit or harm, (2) speech, e.g. to swear by other than Allah and (3) action, e.g. to bow or prostrate to other than Allah.)
me19.tl: Allahumma AAalimal-ghaybi washshahadah, fatiras-samawati wal-ard, rabba kulli shayin wamaleekah, ashhadu an la ilaha illa ant, aAAoothu bika min sharri nafsee wamin sharrish-shaytani washirkih, waan aqtarifa AAala nafsee soo-an aw ajurrahu ila muslim.
me19.s: Al-Tirmidhi, No. 3392, and Abu Dawood, No. 5067. See: Sahih Al-Tirmidhi, 3/142.
me19.sa: الترمذي، برقم 3392، وأبو داود، برقم 5067،. وانظر: صحيح الترمذي، 3/142.

me20.ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لاَ يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلاَ فِي السّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
me20.tr: In the name of Allah with whose name nothing is harmed on earth nor in the heavens and He is The All-Seeing, The All-Knowing.
me20.tl: Bismil-lahil-lathee la yadurru maAAas-mihi shay-on fil-ardi wala fis-sama-i wahuwas-sameeAAul-AAaleem.
me20.v: Whoever recites it three times in the morning will not be afflicted by any calamity before evening, and whoever recites it three times in the evening will not be overtaken by any calamity before morning.
me20.va: من قالها ثلاثاً إذا أصبح، وثلاثاً إذا أمسى لم يضره شيء
me20.s: It was narrated by Abu Dawood, 4/323, No. 5088, Al-Tirmidhi, 5/465, No. 3388, Ibn Majah, No. 3869, and Ahmad, No. 446. See: Sahih Ibn Majah, 2/332. Sheikh Ibn Baz classified the isnad as hasan in Tuhfat Al-Akhyar, p. 39.
me20.sa: أخرجه أبو داود، 4/ 323، برقم، 5088، والترمذي، 5/ 465، برقم 3388، وابن ماجه، برقم 3869، وأحمد، برقم 446. وانظر: صحيح ابن ماجه، 2/332، وحسّن إسناده العلامة ابن باز ‘ في تحفة الأخيار، ص39.

me21.ar: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبَّاً، وَبِالْإِسْلاَمِ دِيناً، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ نَبِيًّا
me21.tr: I am pleased with Allah as a Lord, and Islam as a religion and Muhammad as a Prophet.
me21.tl: Radeetu billahi rabban wabil-islami deenan wabiMuhammadin nabiyya.
me21.v: Allah has promised that anyone who says this three times every morning or evening will be pleased on the Day of Resurrection.
me21.va: من قالها ثلاثاً حين يصبح وثلاثاً حين يمسي كان حقاً على اللَّه أن يرضيه يوم القيامة
me21.s: Ahmad, 4/337, No. 18967, Al-Nasa'i in 'Amal Al-Yawm wal-Laylah, No. 4, Ibn Al-Sunni, No. 68, Abu Dawood, 4/318, No. 1531, and Al-Tirmidhi, 5/465, No. 3389. Sheikh Ibn Baz classified it as hasan in Tuhfat Al-Akhyar, p. 39.
me21.sa: أحمد، 4/ 337، برقم 18967، والنسائي في عمل اليوم والليلة، برقم 4، وابن السني، برقم 68، وأبو داود، 4/ 318، برقم 1531، والترمذي، 5/ 465، برقم، 3389، وحسّنه ابن باز ‘ في تحفة الأخيار ص39.

me22.ar: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغيثُ أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِيَ كُلَّهُ وَلاَ تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ
me22.tr: O Ever Living, O Self-Subsisting and Supporter of all, by Your mercy I seek assistance, rectify for me all of my affairs and do not leave me to myself, even for the blink of an eye.
me22.tl: Ya hayyu ya qayyoom, birahmatika astagheeth, aslih lee sha/nee kullah, wala takilnee ila nafsee tarfata AAayn.
me22.s: Its chain of transmission is sound (Sahih), Al-Hakim 1/545, see Albani, Sahihut-Targhib wat-Tarhib, 1/273.
me22.sa: الحاكم وصححه، ووافقه الذهبي، 1/545، وانظر: صحيح الترغيب والترهيب، 1/273.

me23.ar: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذَا الْيَوْمِ: فَتْحَهُ، وَنَصْرَهُ، وَنورَهُ، وَبَرَكَتَهُ، وَهُدَاهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِيهِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ
me23.tr: We have reached the morning and at this very time all sovereignty belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds. O Allah, I ask You for the good of this day, its triumphs and its victories, its light and its blessings and its guidance, and I take refuge in You from the evil of this day and the evil that follows it.
me23.tl: Asbahna wa-asbahal-mulku lillahi rabbil-AAalameen, allahumma innee as-aluka khayra hathal-yawm, fat-hahu, wanasrahu, wanoorahu, wabarakatahu, wahudahu, wa-aAAoothu bika min sharri ma feehi, washarri ma baAAdah.
me23.s: Abu Dawud 4/322. Its transmission chain is good (Hasan). See also Ibn Al-Qayyim, Zadul- Ma'ad 2/273.
me23.sa: أبو داود، 4/ 322، برقم 5084، وحسن إسناده شعيب وعبد القادر الأرناؤوط في تحقيق زاد المعاد، 2/373.

me24.ar: أَمْسَيْنا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ للهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمَيْنِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّي أسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذَه اللَّيْلَةِ فَتْحَهَا ونَصْرَهَا، ونُوْرَهَا وبَرَكَتهَا، وَهُدَاهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فيهِا وَشَرَّ مَا بَعْدَهَا
me24.tr: We have reached the evening and at this very time all sovereignty belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds. O Allah, I ask You for the good of tonight, its triumphs and its victories, its light and its blessings and its guidance, and I take refuge in You from the evil of tonight and the evil that follows it.
me24.tl: Amsayna wa-amsal-mulku lillahi rabbil-AAalameen, allahumma innee as-aluka khayra hathihil-laylah, fat-haha, wanasraha, wanooraha, wabarakataha, wahudaha, wa-aAAoothu bika min sharri ma feeha, washarri ma baAAdaha.
me24.s: Abu Dawud 4/322. Its transmission chain is good (Hasan). See also Ibn Al-Qayyim, Zadul- Ma'ad 2/273.
me24.sa: أبو داود، 4/ 322، برقم 5084، وحسن إسناده شعيب وعبد القادر الأرناؤوط في تحقيق زاد المعاد، 2/373.

me25.ar: أَصْبَحْنا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلاَمِ، وَعَلَى كَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلاَصِ، وَعَلَى دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ، وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَنِيفاً مُسْلِماً وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشرِكِينَ
me25.tr: We rise upon the fitrah of Islam, and the word of pure faith, and upon the religion of our Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, and the religion of our forefather Ibraheem, who was a Muslim and of true faith and was not of those who associate others with Allah.
me25.tl: Asbahna AAala fitratil-islam, waAAala kalimatil-ikhlas, waAAala deeni nabiyyina Muhammad ﷺ, waAAala millati abeena Ibraheem, haneefan musliman wama kana minal-mushrikeen.
me25.s: Ahmad, 3/406 and 407, nos. 15360 and 15563, and Ibn Al-Sunni in 'Amal Al-Yawm wal-Laylah, No. 34. See: Sahih Al-Jami', 4/209.
me25.sa: أحمد، 3/ 406، و407، برقم 15360، ورقم 15563، وابن السني في عمل اليوم والليلة، برقم 34، وانظر: صحيح الجامع، 4/209.

me26.ar: أمسينا على فطرة الإسلام، وَعَلَى كَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلاَصِ، وَعَلَى دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ، وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَنِيفاً مُسْلِماً وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشرِكِينَ
me26.tr: We have entered the evening upon the fitrah of Islam, and the word of pure faith, and upon the religion of our Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, and the religion of our forefather Ibraheem, who was a Muslim and of true faith and was not of those who associate others with Allah.
me26.tl: Amsayna AAala fitratil-islam, waAAala kalimatil-ikhlas, waAAala deeni nabiyyina Muhammad ﷺ, waAAala millati abeena Ibraheem, haneefan musliman wama kana minal-mushrikeen.
me26.s: Ahmad, 3/406 and 407, nos. 15360 and 15563, and Ibn Al-Sunni in 'Amal Al-Yawm wal-Laylah, No. 34. See: Sahih Al-Jami', 4/209.
me26.sa: أحمد، 3/ 406، و407، برقم 15360، ورقم 15563، وابن السني في عمل اليوم والليلة، برقم 34، وانظر: صحيح الجامع، 4/209.

me27.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْماً نَافِعاً، وَرِزْقاً طَيِّباً، وَعَمَلاً مُتَقَبَّلاً
me27.tr: O Allah, I ask You for knowledge which is beneficial and sustenance which is good, and deeds which are acceptable.
me27.tl: Allahumma innee as-aluka AAilman nafiAAan, warizqan tayyiban, waAAamalan mutaqabbalan.
me27.s: It was narrated by Ibn Al-Sunni in 'Amal Al-Yawm wal-Laylah, No. 54, and by Ibn Majah, No. 925. The chain of transmission was classified as hasan by 'Abd al-Qadir and Shu'ayb al-Arna'ut in their verification of Zad Al-Ma'ad, 2/375.
me27.sa: أخرجه ابن السني في ((عمل اليوم والليلة)) برقم (54)، وابن ماجة برقم (925)، وحسن إسناده عبدالقادر وشعيب الأرناؤوط، في تحقيق ((زاد المعاد)) (2/375).

me28.ar: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
me28.tr: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent.
me28.tl: La ilaha illal-lah, wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shay-in qadeer.
me28.v: Ten times or once when feeling lazy, and whoever says it ten times, it is as if he has freed four souls from the descendants of Isma'il.
me28.va: عشرَ مرَّات أَوْ مرَّةً واحدةً عندَ الكَسَلِ، ومن قالها عَشْرَ مِرَارٍ كَانَ كَمَنْ أَعْتَقَ أَرْبَعَةَ أَنْفُسٍ مِنْ وَلَدِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ.
me28.s: Sahih Al-Bukhari: 6404, Sahih Muslim: 2693, Al-Nasa'i in 'Amal Al-Yawm wal-Laylah, No. 24. See: Sahih Al-Targhib wal-Tarhib, 1/272, Tuhfat Al-Akhyar by Ibn Baz, p. 44, and its virtue in: p. 146, hadith No. 255. Once when feeling lazy: Abu Dawood, No. 5077, Ibn Majah, No. 3798, Ahmad, No. 8719. See: Sahih Al-Targhib wal-Tarhib, 1/270, Sahih Abi Dawood, 3/957, Sahih Ibn Majah, 2/331, and Zad Al-Ma'ad, 2/377.
me28.sa: صحيح البخاري: 6404، صحيح مسلم: 2693، النسائي في عمل اليوم والليلة، برقم 24، وانظر: صحيح الترغيب والترهيب، 1/272، وتحفة الأخيار لابن باز ‘، ص44، وانظر فضلها في: ص146، حديث، رقم 255 مرَّةً واحدةً عندَ الكَسَلِ: أبو داود، برقم 5077، وابن ماجه، برقم 3798، وأحمد، برقم 8719، وانظر: صحيح الترغيب والترهيب، 1/270، وصحيح أبي داود، 3/957، وصحيح ابن ماجه، 2/331، وزاد المعاد، 2/377.

me29.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى نَبَيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ
me29.tr: O Allaah, send prayers and peace upon our Prophet Muhammad.
me29.tl: Allaahumma salli wa sallim 'alaa Nabiyyinaa Muhammadin
me29.v: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Who recites blessings upon me ten times in the morning and ten times in the evening will obtain my intercession on the Day of Resurrection.
me29.va: من صلّى عليَّ حين يصبح عشراً، وحين يمسي عشراً، أدركته شفاعتي يوم القيامة
me29.s: It was narrated by Al-Tabarani with two isnads, one of which is good. See: Majma' Al-Zawa'id, 10/120, and Sahih Al-Targhib wal-Tarhib, 1/273 [No. 656], and Da'if Al-Targhib wal-Tarhib, No. 396, and in Al-Silsilah Al-Da'ifah, No. 5788.
me29.sa: أخرجه الطبراني بإسنادين أحدهما جيد، انظر: مجمع الزوائد (10/120)، وصحيح الترغيب والترهيب (1/273) [برقم (656)]، وضعيف الترغيب والترهيب برقم: 396. وفي السلسلة الضعيفة برقم: 5788.

me30.ar: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
me30.tr: I take refuge in Allah’s perfect words from the evil He has created.
me30.tl: aAAoothu bikalimatil-lahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq.
me30.v: Whoever recites this three times in the evening will be protected from insect stings
me30.va: من قالها حين يمسي ثلاث مرات لم تضرّه حُمَة تلك الليلة
me30.s: Ahmad 2/ 290, An-Nasa'i, 'Amalul-Yawm wal-Laylah No. 590, At-Tirmidhi 3/187, Ibn As-Sunni No. 68. According to Al-Albani, Ibn Majah's (2/266) chain of transmission is sound (Sahih), and following Ibn Baz 45, At-Tirmidhi's report is good (Hasan).
me30.sa: ، أخرجه أحمد، 2/ 290، برقم 7898، والنسائي في عمل اليوم والليلة، برقم 590، وابن السني، برقم 68، وانظر: صحيح الترمذي، 3/187، وصحيح ابن ماجه، 2/266، وتحفة الأخيار لابن باز، ص45.

me31.ar: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ: عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ، وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ، وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ، وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ
me31.tr: How perfect Allah is and I praise Him by the number of His creation and His pleasure, and by the weight of His throne, and the ink of His words.
me31.tl: Subhanal-lahi wabihamdih, AAadada khalqihi warida nafsih, wazinata AAarshih, wamidada kalimatih.

me32.ar: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
me32.tr: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent.
me32.tl: La ilaha illal-lah, wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shay-in qadeer.
me32.v: Whoever recites this one hundred times a day will have the reward of freeing ten slaves. One hundred Hasanaat (rewards) will be written for him and one hundred misdeeds will be washed away. He will be shielded from Satan until the evening. No one will be able to present anything better than this except for someone who has recited more than this.
me32.va: من قالها مائة مرة في يوم كانت له عدل عشر رقاب، وكُتِبَ له مائة حسنة، ومُحيت عنه مائة سيئة، وكانت له حرزاً من الشيطان يومه ذلك حتى يمسي، ولم يأت أحد بأفضل مما جاء به إلا أحد عمل أكثر من ذلك
me32.s: Al-Bukhari, 4/95, No. 3293, and Muslim, 4/2071, No. 2691. Ten times: Al-Nasa'i in 'Amal Al-Yawm wal-Laylah, No. 24. See: Sahih Al-Targhib wal-Tarhib, 1/272, and Tuhfat Al-Akhyar by Ibn Baz, p. 44, and its virtue in: p. 146, hadith No. 255. Once when feeling lazy: Abu Dawood, No. 5077, Ibn Majah, No. 3798, Ahmad, No. 8719. See: Sahih Al-Targhib wal-Tarhib, 1/270, Sahih Abi Dawood, 3/957, Sahih Ibn Majah, 2/331, and Zad Al-Ma'ad, 2/377.
me32.sa:
البخاري، 4/ 95، برقم 3293، ومسلم، 4/ 2071، برقم 2691
عشرَ مرَّات: النسائي في عمل اليوم والليلة، برقم 24، وانظر: صحيح الترغيب والترهيب، 1/272، وتحفة الأخيار لابن باز ‘، ص44، وانظر فضلها في: ص146، حديث، رقم 255 مرَّةً واحدةً عندَ الكَسَلِ: أبو داود، برقم 5077، وابن ماجه، برقم 3798، وأحمد، برقم 8719، وانظر: صحيح الترغيب والترهيب، 1/270، وصحيح أبي داود، 3/957، وصحيح ابن ماجه، 2/331، وزاد المعاد، 2/377.

me33.tr: I seek Allaah’s forgiveness and I turn to Him in repentance.

me34.tr: How perfect Allah is and I praise Him.
me34.v: Whoever recites this one hundred times in the morning and in the evening will not be surpassed on the Day of Resurrection by anyone having done better than this except for someone who had recited it more.
me34.va: من قالها مائة مرة حين يصبح وحين يمسي لم يأت أحد يوم القيامة بأفضل مما جاء به إلا أحد قال مثل ما قال أو زاد عليه

ap1.v: When the Messenger of Allah, sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam, finished his prayer, he would seek forgiveness three times and recite the dhikr above. Al-Auza'i stated that the recitation of istighfar is 'Astaghfirullah, Astaghfirullah.'

ap2.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلاَمُ، وَمِنْكَ السَّلاَمُ، تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلاَلِ وَاْلإِكْرَامِ
ap2.tr: O Allah, You are Peace, and from You is peace. Blessed are You, O Possessor of majesty and honor.
ap2.tl: allahumma antas-salam wa minkas-salam tabarakta ya dhal-jalali wal-ikram
ap2.v: When the Messenger of Allah, sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam, finished his prayer, he would seek forgiveness three times and recite the dhikr above. Al-Auza'i stated that the recitation of istighfar is 'Astaghfirullah, Astaghfirullah.'

hm59.ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ, وَشُكْرِكَ, وَحُسْنِ عِبادَتِكَ
hm59.tr: O Allah, help me to remember You, to give You thanks, and to perform Your worship in the best manner.
hm59.r: Abu Dawud 2/86, An-Nasa'i 3/53, Sahih Abu Dawud 1 /284
hm59.s: Abu Dawud 2/86, An-Nasa'i 3/53, Sahih Abu Dawud 1 /284.

ap3.ar: لاَ إِلَـهَ إِلاَّ اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيْكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرُ، اَللَّهُمَّ لاَ مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَلاَ مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ، وَلاَ يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الْجَدُّ
ap3.tr: There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone, He has no partner. To Him belongs dominion and praise, and He is over all things competent. O Allah, there is no preventer of what You give, and no giver of what You withhold, and wealth and honor do not benefit their possessor (except faith and righteous deeds that save from punishment). Only from You is wealth and honor.
ap3.tl: la ilaha illa allah wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir. allahumma la mani'a lima a'tayta wa la mu'tiya lima mana'ta wa la yanfa'u dhal-jaddi minkal-jaddu
ap3.s: HR. Bukhari No. 844 and Muslim No. 593

ap4.ar: لاَ إِلَـهَ إِلاَّ اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيْكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرُ. لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللهِ، لاَ إِلَـهَ إِلاَّ اللهُ، وَلاَ نَعْبُدُ إِلاَّ إِيَّاهُ، لَهُ النِّعْمَةُ وَلَهُ الْفَضْلُ وَلَهُ الثَّنَاءُ الْحَسَنُ، لاَ إِلَـهَ إِلاَّ اللهُ مُخْلِصِيْنَ لَهُ الدِّيْنَ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْكَافِرُوْنَ
ap4.tr: There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone, He has no partner. To Him belongs dominion and praise, and He is over all things competent. There is no power and no strength except by Allah. There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah, and we do not worship except Him. To Him belongs all favor, grace, and good praise. There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah, making our religion sincerely for Him, even if the disbelievers dislike it.
ap4.tl: la ilaha illa allah wahdahu la sharika lah. lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir. la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah. la ilaha illa allah wa la na'budu illa iyyah. lahun-ni'mah wa lahul-fadl wa lahuth-thana'ul-hasan. la ilaha illa allah mukhlisina lahud-dina wa law karihal-kafirun
ap4.v: 'Abdullah bin Zubair said, "The Prophet, sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam, used to recite the tahlil (laa ilaha illallah) at the end of the prayer."

ap8.ar: لاَ إِلَـهَ إِلاَّ اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيْكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرُ
ap8.tr: There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone, He has no partner. To Him belongs dominion and praise, and He is over all things competent.
ap8.tl: la ilaha illa allah wahdahu la sharika lah. lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir
ap8.v: Whoever recites the dhikr above, his sins will be forgiven, even if they are as numerous as the foam on the ocean. Imam Nawawi, may Allah have mercy on him, said that the text of the hadith indicates that 'Subhanallah', 'Alhamdulillah', and 'Allahu akbar' are each recited 33 times separately.

ap9.ar: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْحَىُّ ٱلْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُۥ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَّهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ مَن ذَا ٱلَّذِى يَشْفَعُ عِندَهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِۦ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَىْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِۦٓ إِلَّا بِمَا شَآءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَـُٔودُهُۥ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِىُّ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
ap9.tr: Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of [all] existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.
ap9.tl: allahu la ilaha illa huwa, al-hayyul-qayyum. la ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa la nawm. lahu ma fis-samawati wa ma fil-ard. man dhal-ladhi yashfa'u 'indahu illa bi-idhnihi. ya'lamu ma bayna aydihim wa ma khalfahum. wa la yuhituna bishay'in min 'ilmihi illa bima sha'. wa si'a kursiyyuhu as-samawati wal-ard. wa la ya'udu-hu hifdhuhuma. wa huwa al-'aliyyul-'azim
ap9.v: Whoever recites Ayat al-Kursi after finishing the prayer, nothing will prevent him from entering Paradise except death.
ap9.s: HR. an-Nasai in Al-Kubro 9: 44. This hadith is declared sahih by Ibn Hibban, as mentioned by Ibn Hajar in Bulugh al-Maram

ap10.ar: قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ (1) ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ (2) لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ (3) وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌۢ (4)
ap10.tr: Say, "He is Allah , [who is] One, (1) Allah , the Eternal Refuge. (2) He neither begets nor is born, (3) Nor is there to Him any equivalent." (4)
ap10.tl: qul huwa allahu ahad (1) allahu samad (2) lam yalid wa lam yulad (3) wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan ahad (4)
ap10.s: HR. Abu Dawud No. 1523 and an-Nasa'i No. 1337. Al-Hafiz Abu Tahir said that the chain of this hadith is hasan

ap11.ar: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ (1) مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ (2) وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ (3) وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّٰثَٰتِ فِى ٱلْعُقَدِ (4) وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ (5)
ap11.tr: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak (1) From the evil of that which He created (2) And from the evil of darkness when it settles (3) And from the evil of the blowers in knots (4) And from the evil of an envier when he envies." (5)
ap11.tl: qul a'udhu birabbil-falaq (1) min sharri ma khalaq (2) wa min sharri ghasiqin idha waqab (3) wa min sharri naffathati fil-'uqad (4) wa min sharri hasidin idha hasad (5)
ap11.s: HR. Abu Dawud No. 1523 and an-Nasa'i No. 1337. Al-Hafiz Abu Tahir said that the chain of this hadith is hasan

ap12.ar: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ (1) مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ (2) إِلَٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ (3) مِن شَرِّ ٱلْوَسْوَاسِ ٱلْخَنَّاسِ (4) ٱلَّذِى يُوَسْوِسُ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ (5) مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ (6)
ap12.tr: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, (1) The King of mankind. (2) The God of mankind, (3) From the evil of the whisperer who withdraws, (4) Who whispers in the breasts of mankind, (5) Of the jinn and mankind." (6)
ap12.tl: qul a'udhu birabbin-nas (1) malikin-nas (2) ilahin-nas (3) min sharri al-waswasi al-khannas (4) alladhi yuwaswisu fi sudurin-nas (5) mina al-jinnati wan-nas (6)
ap12.s: HR. Abu Dawud No. 1523 and an-Nasa'i No. 1337. Al-Hafiz Abu Tahir said that the chain of this hadith is hasan

hm72.ar: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ, لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
hm72.tr: None has the right to be worshiped but Allah alone, Who has no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise. He brings life and He causes death, and He is Able to do all things.
hm72.v: Ten times after the Maghrib and Fajr prayers.

ap13.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّى أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا وَعَمَلاً مُتَقَبَّلاً
ap13.tr: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, good provision, and accepted deeds.
ap13.tl: allahumma inni as'aluka 'ilman nafi'an, wa rizqan tayyiban, wa 'amalan mutaqabbalan
ap13.v: Beneficial knowledge is a provision that makes life easier, obtaining good provision is a person's goal in working, and accepted deeds are the hope of every person who performs good deeds. Therefore, a servant should always ask for these 3 things every morning before starting their various activities.
ap13.s: HR. Ibn Majah No. 925 and Ahmad 6: 305, 322. Al-Hafiz Abu Tahir said that this hadith is sahih

hm119.ar:
يَجْمَعُ كَفَّيْهِ ثُمَّ يَنْفُثُ فِيهِمَا فَيَقْرَأُ فِيهِمَا:
بسم الله الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ ﴿قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ * اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ* لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ* وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُواً أَحَدٌ﴾.
بسم الله الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ ﴿قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ* مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ* وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ* وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ* وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ﴾.
بسم الله الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ ﴿قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ* مَلِكِ النَّاسِ* إِلَهِ النَّاسِ* مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ* الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ* مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَ النَّاسِ﴾
ثُمَّ يَمْسَحُ بِهِمَا مَا اسْتَطَاعَ مِنْ جَسَدِهِ يَبْدَأُ بِهِمَا عَلَى رَأْسِهِ وَوَجْهِهِ وَمَا أَقبَلَ مِنْ جَسَدِهِ

hm120.ar: اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لاَ تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلاَ نَوْمٌ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الأَرْضِ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلاَ يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلاَّ بِمَا شَاء وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ وَلاَ يَؤُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ
hm120.tr: Allah! There is no God but He, the Ever Living, the One Who sustains and protects all that exists. Neither slumber nor sleep overtakes Him. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is he that can intercede with Him except with His Permission? He knows what happens to them in this world, and what will happen to them in the Hereafter. And they will never encompass anything of His Knowledge except that which He wills. His Throne extends over the heavens and the earth, and He feels no fatigue in guarding and preserving them. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.
hm120.v: Whoever reads this when he lies down to sleep will have a guardian from Allah remain with him and Satan will not be able to come near him until he rises in the morning.

hm121.ar: آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِن رَّبِّهِ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ كُلٌّ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَمَلآئِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ لاَ نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِّن رُّسُلِهِ وَقَالُواْ سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ* لاَ يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْساً إِلاَّ وُسْعَهَا لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ رَبَّنَا لاَ تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِن نَّسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا رَبَّنَا وَلاَ تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْراً كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا رَبَّنَا وَلاَ تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لاَ طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَآ أَنتَ مَوْلاَنَا فَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
hm121.tr: The Messenger has believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord, and [so have] the believers. All of them have believed in Allah and His angels and His books and His messengers, (saying), "We make no distinction between any of His messengers." And they say, "We hear and we obey. (We seek) Your forgiveness, our Lord, and to You is the (final) destination." Allah does not charge a soul except (with that within) its capacity. It will have (the consequence of) what (good) it has gained, and it will bear (the consequence of) what (evil) it has earned. "Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we have forgotten or erred. Our Lord, and lay not upon us a burden like that which You laid upon those before us. Our Lord, and burden us not with that which we have no ability to bear. And pardon us; and forgive us; and have mercy upon us. You are our protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people."
hm121.v: These two Verses will be sufficient for anyone who recites them at night before sleeping.

hm122.ar: بِاسْمِكَ رَبِّي وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي, وَبِكَ أَرْفَعُهُ, فَإِن أَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِي فارْحَمْهَا, وَإِنْ أَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا, بِمَا تَحْفَظُ بِهِ عِبَادَكَ الصَّالِحِينَ
hm122.tr: With Your Name my Lord, I lay myself down and with Your Name I rise. And if my soul You take, have mercy on it, and if You send it back then protect it as You protect Your righteous slaves.
hm122.v: If any of you rises from his bed and later returns to it, let him dust off his bed with his waist garment three times and mention the Name of Allah, for he does not know what may have entered the bed after him, and when he lies down he should say: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ

hm123.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ خَلَقْتَ نَفْسِي وَأَنْتَ تَوَفَّاهَا, لَكَ مَمَاتُهَا وَمَحْياهَا, إِنْ أَحْيَيْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا, وَإِنْ أَمَتَّهَا فَاغْفِرْ لَهَا. اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ العَافِيَةَ
hm123.tr: O Allah, You have created my soul and You take it back. Unto You is its death and its life. If You give it life then protect it, and if You cause it to die then forgive it. O Allah, I ask You for strength.

hm124.ar: اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ
hm124.tr: O Allah, save me from Your punishment on the Day that You resurrect Your slaves.

hm125.tr: In Your Name, O Allah, I die and I live.

hm127.ar: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَرَبَّ الأَرْضِ, وَرَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ, رَبَّنَا وَرَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ, فَالِقَ الْحَبِّ وَالنَّوَى, وَمُنْزِلَ التَّوْرَاةِ وَالْإِنْجِيلِ, وَالْفُرْقَانِ, أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهِ. اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الأَوَّلُ فَلَيْسَ قَبْلَكَ شَيْءٌ, وَأَنْتَ الآخِرُ فَلَيسَ بَعْدَكَ شَيْءٌ, وَأَنْتَ الظَّاهِرُ فَلَيْسَ فَوْقَكَ شَيْءٌ, وَأَنْتَ الْبَاطِنُ فَلَيْسَ دُونَكَ شَيْءٌ, اقْضِ عَنَّا الدَّيْنَ وَأَغْنِنَا مِنَ الْفَقْرِ
hm127.tr: O Allah! Lord of the Seven heavens and Lord of the Magnificent Throne. Our Lord and the Lord of everything. Splitter of the grain and the date-stone, Revealer of the Torah and the Injeel and the Furqan (the Qur'an), I seek refuge in You from the evil of everything that You shall seize by the forelock. O Allah You are the First and nothing has come before you, and You are the Last, and nothing may come after You. You are the Most High, nothing is above You and You are the Most Near and nothing is nearer than You. Remove our debts from us and enrich us against poverty.

hm128.ar: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا, وَكَفَانَا, وَآوَانَا, فَكَمْ مِمَّنْ لاَ كَافِيَ لَهُ وَلاَ مُؤْوِيَ
hm128.tr: Praise is to Allah Who has provided us with food and with drink, sufficed us and gave us an abode for how many are there with no provision and no home.

hm129.ar: اللَّهُمَّ عَالِمَ الغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ فَاطِرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ, رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ, أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ, أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي, وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطانِ وَشِرْكِهِ, وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَى نَفْسِي سُوءاً, أَوْ أَجُرَّهُ إِلَى مُسْلِمٍ
hm129.tr: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the evident, Maker of the heavens and the earth, Lord of everything and its Master, I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship but You. I seek refuge in You from the evil of my soul and from the evil of Satan and his helpers. (I seek refuge in You) from bringing evil upon my soul and from harming any Muslim.
hm129.tl: Allahumma AAalimal-ghaybi washshahadah, fatiras-samawati wal-ard, rabba kulli shayin wamaleekah, ashhadu an la ilaha illa ant, aAAoothu bika min sharri nafsee wamin sharrish-shaytani washirkih, waan aqtarifa AAala nafsee soo-an aw ajurrahu ila muslim.

hm130.ar: يَقْرَأُ ﴿الم﴾ تَنْزِيلَ السَّجْدَةِ, وَ(تَبَارَكَ الَّذي بِيَدِهِ الْمُلْكُ)

hm131.ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ نَفْسِي إِلَيْكَ, وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي إِلَيْكَ, وَوَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِي إِلَيْكَ, وَأَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَيْكَ, رَغْبَةً وَرَهْبَةً إِلَيْكَ, لاَ مَلْجَأَ وَلاَ مَنْجَا مِنْكَ إِلاَّ إِلَيْكَ, آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ, وَبِنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ
hm131.tr: O Allah, I submit myself to You, entrust my affairs to You, turn my face to You, and lay myself down depending upon You, hoping in You and fearing You. There is no refuge, and no escape, except to You. I believe in Your Book (the Qur'an) that You revealed, and the Prophet whom You sent.
hm131.v: Before you go to bed perform ablutions as you would for prayer, then lie down on your right side and says this dua'. Whoever says this and dies in his sleep, has died in a state of the natural monotheism (Fitrah).

hm1.ar: الْحَمْدُ للَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا, وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
hm1.tr: Praise is to Allah Who gives us life after He has caused us to die and to Him is the return.
hm1.tl: alhamdulillahilladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa ilayhin-nushur

hm2.ar: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَريكَ لَهُ, لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ, وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ, سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ, وَالْحَمْدُ للَّهِ, وَلاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ, وَاللَّهُ أَكبَرُ, وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ, رَبِّ اغْفرْ لِي
hm2.tr: There is none worth of worship but Allah alone, Who has no partner, His is the dominion and to Him belongs all praise, and He is able to do all things. Glory is to Allah. Praise is to Allah. There is none worth of worship but Allah. Allah is the Most Great. There is no might and no power except by Allah's leave, the Exalted, the Mighty. My Lord, forgive me.
hm2.v: Whoever says this will be forgiven, and if he supplicates Allah, his prayer will be answered; if he performs ablution and prays, his prayer will be accepted.
hm2.r: Al-Bukhari, cf. Al-Asqalani, Fathul-Bari 3/39, Ibn Majah 2/335
hm2.s: Al-Bukhari, cf. Al-Asqalani, Fathul-Bari 3/39, Ibn Majah 2/335.

hm3.ar: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي فِي جَسَدِي, وَرَدَّ عَلَيَّ رُوحِي, وَأَذِنَ لي بِذِكْرِهِ
hm3.tr: Praise is to Allah Who gave strength to my body and returned my soul to me and permitted me to remember Him.

hm4.ar: إِنَّ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَاخْتِلاَفِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ لَآيَاتٍ لأُوْلِي الألْبَابِ * الَّذِينَ يَذْكُرُونَ اللَّهَ قِيَاماً وَقُعُوداً وَعَلَىَ جُنُوبِهِمْ وَيَتَفَكَّرُونَ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ رَبَّنَا مَا خَلَقْتَ هَذا بَاطِلاً سُبْحَانَكَ فَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ* رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ مَن تُدْخِلِ النَّارَ فَقَدْ أَخْزَيْتَهُ وَمَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ مِنْ أَنصَارٍ* رَّبَّنَا إِنَّنَا سَمِعْنَا مُنَادِياً يُنَادِي لِلإِيمَانِ أَنْ آمِنُواْ بِرَبِّكُمْ فَآمَنَّا رَبَّنَا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَكَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّئَاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ الأبْرَارِ* رَبَّنَا وَآتِنَا مَا وَعَدتَّنَا عَلَى رُسُلِكَ وَلاَ تُخْزِنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ إِنَّكَ لاَ تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ* فَاسْتَجَابَ لَهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ أَنِّي لاَ أُضِيعُ عَمَلَ عَامِلٍ مِّنكُم مِّن ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أُنثَى بَعْضُكُم مِّن بَعْضٍ فَالَّذِينَ هَاجَرُواْ وَأُخْرِجُواْ مِن دِيَارِهِمْ وَأُوذُواْ فِي سَبِيلِي وَقَاتَلُواْ وَقُتِلُواْ لأُكَفِّرَنَّ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ وَلأُدْخِلَنَّهُمْ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الأَنْهَارُ ثَوَاباً مِّن عِندِ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ عِندَهُ حُسْنُ الثَّوَابِ * لاَ يَغُرَّنَّكَ تَقَلُّبُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فِي الْبِلاَدِ * مَتَاعٌ قَلِيلٌ ثُمَّ مَأْوَاهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ وَبِئْسَ الْمِهَادُ * لَكِنِ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْاْ رَبَّهُمْ لَهُمْ جَنَّاتٌ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا نُزُلاً مِّنْ عِندِ اللَّهِ وَمَا عِندَ اللَّهِ خَيْرٌ لِّلأَبْرَارِ * وَإِنَّ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ لَمَن يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِمْ خَاشِعِينَ لِلَّهِ لاَ يَشْتَرُونَ بِآيَاتِ اللَّهِ ثَمَناً قَلِيلاً أُوْلَئِكَ لَهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَرِيعُ الْحِسَابِ*يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُواْ اصْبِرُواْ وَصَابِرُواْ وَرَابِطُواْ وَاتَّقُواْ اللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
hm4.tr: Indeed, in the creation of the heavens and the earth and the alternation of the night and the day are signs for those of understanding.190 Who remember Allah while standing or sitting or (lying) on their sides and give thought to the creation of the heavens and the earth, (saying), "Our Lord, You did not create this aimlessly; exalted are You (above such a thing); then protect us from the punishment of the Fire.191 Our Lord, indeed whoever You admit to the Fire - You have disgraced him, and for the wrongdoers there are no helpers.192 Our Lord, indeed we have heard a caller calling to faith, (saying), 'Believe in your Lord,' and we have believed. Our Lord, so forgive us our sins and remove from us our misdeeds and cause us to die with the righteous.193 Our Lord, and grant us what You promised us through Your messengers and do not disgrace us on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed, You do not fail in (Your) promise.194 And their Lord responded to them, "Never will I allow to be lost the work of (any) worker among you, whether male or female; you are of one another. So those who emigrated or were evicted from their homes or were harmed in My cause or fought or were killed - I will surely remove from them their misdeeds, and I will surely admit them to gardens beneath which rivers flow as reward from Allah , and Allah has with Him the best reward."195 Be not deceived by the (uninhibited) movement of the disbelievers throughout the land.196 (It is but) a small enjoyment; then their (final) refuge is Hell, and wretched is the resting place.197 But those who feared their Lord will have gardens beneath which rivers flow, abiding eternally therein, as accommodation from Allah . And that which is with Allah is best for the righteous.198 And indeed, among the People of the Scripture are those who believe in Allah and what was revealed to you and what was revealed to them, (being) humbly submissive to Allah . They do not exchange the verses of Allah for a small price. Those will have their reward with their Lord. Indeed, Allah is swift in account.199 O you who have believed, persevere and endure and remain stationed and fear Allah that you may be successful.200
hm4.r: Qur'an Al-'Imran 3: 190-200, Al-Bukhari, cf. Al-Asqalani, Fathul-Bari 8/237, Muslim 1/530
hm4.s: Qur'an Al-'Imran 3: 190-200, Al-Bukhari, cf. Al-Asqalani, Fathul-Bari 8/237, Muslim 1/530.

hm274.tr: Glorified is Allah and praised is He
hm274.v: The Prophet (SAW) said: "Whoever says: "Glorified is Allah and praised is He" one hundred times a day, will have his sins forgiven even if they are like the foam of the sea".
hm274.va: قَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَنْ قَالَ: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ فِي يَوْمٍ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ حُطَّتْ خَطَايَاهُ وَلَوْ كَانَتْ مِثْلَ زَبَدِ الْبَحْر

hm275.ar: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ, لَهُ الْمُلْكُ, وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ, وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
hm275.tr: None has the right to be worshiped but Allah alone, Who has no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is Able to do all things
hm275.v: The Prophet (SAW) said: "Whoever says: "None has the right to be worshiped but Allah alone, Who has no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is Able to do all things" ten times, will have the reward for freeing four slaves from the Children of Isma'il".
hm275.va: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: مَنْ قَالَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ, لَهُ الْمُلْكُ, وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ, وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ عَشْرَ مِرَارٍ, كَانَ كَمَنْ أَعْتَقَ أَرْبَعَةَ أَنْفُسٍ مِنْ وَلَدِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ
hm275.tl: La ilaha illal-lah, wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shay-in qadeer.

hm276.ar: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ, سُبْحانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ
hm276.tr: Glorified is Allah and praised is He, Glorified is Allah the Most Great
hm276.v: The Prophet (SAW) said: "Two words are light on the tongue, weigh heavily in the balance, and are loved by the Most Merciful One is: "Glorified is Allah and praised is He, Glorified is Allah the Most Great".
hm276.va: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: كَلِمَتَانِ خَفِيفَتَانِ عَلَى اللِّسَانِ, ثَقِيلَتَانِ فِي الْمِيزَانِ, حَبِيبَتَانِ إِلَى الرَّحْمَنِ: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ, سُبْحانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ

hm277.ar: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ, وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ, وَلاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ, وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
hm277.tr: Glory is to Allah, and praise is to Allah, and there is none worthy of worship but Allah, and Allah is the Most Great
hm277.v: The Prophet (SAW) said: For me to say: "Glory is to Allah, and praise is to Allah, and there is none worthy of worship but Allah, and Allah is the Most Great" is dearer to me than all that the sun rises upon".
hm277.va: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: لَأَنْ أَقُولَ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ, وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ, وَلاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ, وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ, أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِمَّا طَلَعَتْ عَلَيْهِ الشَّمسُ

hm279.tr: Glorified is Allah the Most Great and praised is He
hm279.v: The Prophet (SAW) said: "Glorified is Allah the Most Great and praised is He. Will have a date palm planted for him in Paradise".
hm279.va: مَنْ قَالَ: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ غُرِسَتْ لَهُ نَخْلَةٌ فِي الْجَنَّةِ

hm280.ar: لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ
hm280.tr: There is no power and no might except by Allah
hm280.v: The Prophet (SAW) said: "O Abdullah bin Qais, should I not point you to one of the treasures of Paradise?" I said: "Yes, O Messenger of Allah". So he told me to say: "There is no power and no might except by Allah".
hm280.va: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: (يَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ قَيْسٍ أَلاَ أَدُلُّكَ عَلَى كَنْزٍ مِنْ كُنُوزِ الْجَنَّةِ)؟ فَقُلْتُ: بَلَى يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ, قَالَ: (قُلْ لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ)

hm282.ar: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ, اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ كَبِيراً, وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ كَثِيراً, سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ رَبِّ العَالَمِينَ, لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَكِيمِ
hm282.tr: There is none worthy of worship but Allah, Who has no partner, Allah is the Great, the Most Great, and praise is to Allah in abundance, glory is to Allah, Lord of the worlds. There is no power and no might but by Allah the Mighty, the Wise
hm282.v: A desert Arab came to Allah's Messenger (SAW) and said: "Teach me a word that I can say". The Prophet told him to say: "There is none worthy of worship but Allah, Who has no partner, Allah is the Great, the Most Great, and praise is to Allah in abundance, glory is to Allah, Lord of the worlds. There is no power and no might but by Allah the Mighty, the Wise". (1) He said: "That is for my Lord, but what about me?" The Prophet (SAW) told him to say: "O Allah forgive me, and have mercy on me and guide me, and provide for me". (2)
hm282.va: جَاءَ أَعْرَابِيٌّ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ: عَلِّمْنِي كَلاماً أَقُولُهُ: قَالَ: (قُلْ: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ, اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ كَبِيراً, وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ كَثِيراً, سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ رَبِّ العَالَمِينَ, لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَكِيمِ) قَالَ: فَهَؤُلاَءِ لِرَبِّي, فَمَا لِي؟ قَالَ: (قُلْ: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي, وَارْحَمْنِي, وَاهْدِنِي, وَارْزُقْنِي)

hm285.ar: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ, وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ, وَلاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ, وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ, وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ
hm285.tr: Glorified is Allah, The praise is for Allah, There is none worth of worship but Allah, Allah is the Most Great and There is no power and no might except by Allah
hm285.v: The good deeds which endure are: "Glorified is Allah, The praise is for Allah, There is none worth of worship but Allah, Allah is the Most Great and There is no power and no might except by Allah".
hm285.va: الْبَاقِيَاتُ الصَّالِحَاتُ: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ, وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ, وَلاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ, وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ, وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ

hm270.ar: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الْعَظيمَ الَّذِي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَيُّ القَيّوُمُ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيهِ
hm270.tr: I seek the forgiveness of Allah the Mighty, Whom there is none worthy of worship except Him, the Living, the Eternal, and I repent to Him
hm270.v: Allah will forgive him even if he has deserted the army's ranks.
hm270.va: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: مَنْ قَالَ أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الْعَظيمَ الَّذِي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَيُّ القَيّوُمُ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيهِ, غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ وَإِنْ كَانَ فَرَّ مِنَ الزَّحْفِ

hm57.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي ظُلْماً كَثِيراً, وَلاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ, فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَغْفِرَةً مِنْ عِنْدِكَ وَارْحَمْنِي, إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الغَفورُ الرَّحيمُ
hm57.tr: O Allah, I have greatly wronged myself and no one forgives sins but You. So, grant me forgiveness and have mercy on me. Surely, you are Forgiving, Merciful.

hm58.ar: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي مَا قَدَّمْتُ, وَمَا أَخَّرْتُ, وَمَا أَسْرَرْتُ, وَمَا أَعْلَنْتُ, وَمَا أَسْرَفْتُ, وَمَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّي. أَنْتَ الْمُقَدِّمُ, وَأَنْتَ الْمُؤَخِّرُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
hm58.tr: O Allah, forgive me what I have sent before me and what I have left behind me, what I have concealed and what I have done openly, what I have done in excess, and what You are better aware of than I. You are the One Who sends forth and You are the One Who delays. There is none worthy of worship but You.

hm216.ar: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ, أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ, أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ
hm216.tr: Glory is to You, O Allah, and praise is to You. I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship but You. I seek Your forgiveness and repent to You.
hm216.v: Allah's Messenger (SAW) did not sit in a gathering, and did not recite the Qur'an, and did not perform any prayer without concluding by saying this invocation.
hm216.r: Abu Dawud, Ibn Majah, At-Tirmizi and An-Nasa'i, Ahmad 6/77
hm216.s: Abu Dawud, Ibn Majah, At-Tirmizi and An-Nasa'i, Ahmad 6/77

hm283.ar: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرِ لِي, وَارْحَمْنِي, وَاهْدِنِي, وَعَافِنِي وَارْزُقْنِي
hm283.tr: O Allah forgive me, and have mercy on me and guide me and give me good health and provide for me.
hm283.va: كَانَ الرَّجُلُ إِذَا أَسْلَمَ عَلَّمَهُ النَّبيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الصَّلاَةَ ثُمَّ أَمَرَهُ أَنْ يَدْعُوَ بِهَؤُلاَءِ الْكَلِمَاتِ: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرِ لِي, وَارْحَمْنِي, وَاهْدِنِي, وَعَافِنِي وَارْزُقْنِي

hm53.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ, وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ, كَمَا صَلَّيتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ, وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ, إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ, اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ, كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ, إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
hm53.tr: O Allah, bestow Your favor on Muhammad and on the family of Muhammad as You have bestowed Your favor on Ibrahim and on the family of Ibrahim, You are Praiseworthy, Most Glorious. O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad as You have blessed Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim, You are Praiseworthy, Most Glorious.
hm53.v: The Prophet (SAW) said: "Whoever prays for Allah's blessings upon me once, will be blessed for it by Allah ten times".
hm53.va: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيَّ صَلاَةً صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ بِهَا عَشْراً

hm54.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أَزْوَاجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ, كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ. وَبَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أَزْواجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ, كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ. إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
hm54.tr: O Allah, bestow Your favor on Muhammad and upon his wives and progeny as You have best owed Your favor upon the family of Ibrahim. And bless Muhammad and his wives and progeny as You have blessed the family of Ibrahim, You are full of praise, Most Glorious.
hm54.v: The Prophet (SAW) said: The miser is the one in whose presence I am mentioned yet does not pray for Allah's blessings upon me.
hm54.va: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: الْبَخِيلُ مَنْ ذُكِرْتُ عِنْدَهُ فَلَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيَّ

hm25.ar: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ, وَالصَّلاَةِ الْقَائِمَةِ, آتِ مُحَمَّداً الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ, وَابْعَثْهُ مَقَامَاً مَحمُوداً الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ, [إِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ]
hm25.tr: O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and established prayer. Grant Muhammad the intercession and favor, and raise him to the honored station You have promised him, verily You do not neglect promises.

q2_127.ar: رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
q2_127.tr: Our Lord! Accept from us (this duty). Lo! Thou, only Thou, art the Hearer, the Knower.
q2_127.s: Quran 2:127 (Al-Baqara): Tanzil quran-simple text; translation M. Pickthall

q2_201.ar: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
q2_201.tr: Our Lord! Give unto us in the world that which is good and in the Hereafter that which is good, and guard us from the doom of Fire.
q2_201.s: Quran 2:201 (Al-Baqara): Tanzil quran-simple text; translation M. Pickthall

q3_8.ar: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِنْ لَدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً ۚ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْوَهَّابُ
q3_8.tr: Our Lord! Cause not our hearts to stray after Thou hast guided us, and bestow upon us mercy from Thy Presence. Lo! Thou, only Thou, art the Bestower.
q3_8.s: Quran 3:8 (Aal-i-Imraan): Tanzil quran-simple text; translation M. Pickthall

q3_16.ar: رَبَّنَا إِنَّنَا آمَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
q3_16.tr: Our Lord! Lo! we believe. So forgive us our sins and guard us from the punishment of Fire
q3_16.s: Quran 3:16 (Aal-i-Imraan): Tanzil quran-simple text; translation M. Pickthall

q3_147.ar: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَإِسْرَافَنَا فِي أَمْرِنَا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَانْصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
q3_147.tr: Our Lord! forgive us for our sins and wasted efforts, make our foothold sure, and give us victory over the disbelieving folk.
q3_147.s: Quran 3:147 (Aal-i-Imraan): Tanzil quran-simple text; translation M. Pickthall

q7_23.ar: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنْفُسَنَا وَإِنْ لَمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
q7_23.tr: Our Lord! We have wronged ourselves. If thou forgive us not and have not mercy on us, surely we are of the lost!
q7_23.s: Quran 7:23 (Al-A'raaf): Tanzil quran-simple text; translation M. Pickthall

q14_40.ar: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةِ وَمِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِي ۚ رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَاءِ رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ
q14_40.tr: My Lord! Make me to establish proper worship, and some of my posterity (also); our Lord! and accept my prayer. Our Lord! Forgive me and my parents and believers on the day when the account is cast.
q14_40.s: Quran 14:40-41 (Ibrahim): Tanzil quran-simple text; translation M. Pickthall

q17_24.tr: My Lord! Have mercy on them both as they did care for me when I was little.
q17_24.s: Quran 17:24 (Al-Israa): Tanzil quran-simple text; translation M. Pickthall

q18_10.ar: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا مِنْ لَدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا
q18_10.tr: Our Lord! Give us mercy from Thy presence, and shape for us right conduct in our plight.
q18_10.s: Quran 18:10 (Al-Kahf): Tanzil quran-simple text; translation M. Pickthall

q20_25.ar: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِنْ لِسَانِي يَفْقَهُوا قَوْلِي
q20_25.tr: My Lord! relieve my mind And ease my task for me; And loose a knot from my tongue, That they may understand my saying.
q20_25.s: Quran 20:25-28 (Taa-Haa): Tanzil quran-simple text; translation M. Pickthall

q20_114.tr: My Lord! Increase me in knowledge.
q20_114.s: Quran 20:114 (Taa-Haa): Tanzil quran-simple text; translation M. Pickthall

q23_118.ar: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ وَارْحَمْ وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
q23_118.tr: My Lord! Forgive and have mercy, for Thou art Best of all who show mercy.
q23_118.s: Quran 23:118 (Al-Muminoon): Tanzil quran-simple text; translation M. Pickthall

q25_74.ar: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
q25_74.tr: Our Lord! Vouchsafe us comfort of our wives and of our offspring, and make us patterns for (all) those who ward off (evil).
q25_74.s: Quran 25:74 (Al-Furqaan): Tanzil quran-simple text; translation M. Pickthall

q28_24.ar: رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَا أَنْزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ
q28_24.tr: My Lord! I am needy of whatever good Thou sendest down for me.
q28_24.s: Quran 28:24 (Al-Qasas): Tanzil quran-simple text; translation M. Pickthall

q59_10.ar: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِإِخْوَانِنَا الَّذِينَ سَبَقُونَا بِالْإِيمَانِ وَلَا تَجْعَلْ فِي قُلُوبِنَا غِلًّا لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ رَءُوفٌ رَحِيمٌ
q59_10.tr: Our Lord! Forgive us and our brethren who were before us in the faith, and place not in our hearts any rancour toward those who believe. Our Lord! Thou art Full of Pity, Merciful.
q59_10.s: Quran 59:10 (Al-Hashr): Tanzil quran-simple text; translation M. Pickthall

hm140.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي عَبْدُكَ, ابْنُ عَبْدِكَ, ابْنُ أَمَتِكَ, نَاصِيَتِي بِيَدِكَ, مَاضٍ فِيَّ حُكْمُكَ, عَدْلٌ فِيَّ قَضَاؤُكَ, أَسْأَلُكَ بِكُلِّ اسْمٍ هُوَ لَكَ, سَمَّيْتَ بِهِ نَفْسَكَ, أَوْ أَنْزَلْتَهُ فِي كِتَابِكَ, أَوْ عَلَّمْتَهُ أَحَداً مِنْ خَلْقِكَ, أَوِ اسْتَأْثَرْتَ بِهِ فِي عِلْمِ الغَيْبِ عِنْدَكَ, أَنْ تَجْعَلَ القُرْآنَ رَبِيعَ قَلْبِي, وَنُورَ صَدْرِي, وَجَلاَءَ حُزْنِي, وَذَهَابَ هَمِّي
hm140.tr: O Allah, I am Your slave and the son of Your male slave and the son of your female slave. My forehead is in Your Hand (i.e. You have control over me). Your Judgment upon me is assured and Your Decree concerning me is just. I ask You by every Name that You have named Yourself with, revealed in Your Book, taught any one of Your creation or kept unto Yourself in the knowledge of the unseen that is with You, to make the Qur'an the spring of my heart, and the light of my chest, the banisher of my sadness and the reliever of my distress.
hm140.r: Ahmad 1/391, and Al-Albani graded it authentic
hm140.s: Ahmad 1/391, and Al-Albani graded it authentic.

hm141.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ, وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ, وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ, وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
hm141.tr: O Allah, I seek refuge in you from grief and sadness, from weakness and from laziness, from miserliness and from cowardice, from being overcome by debt and overpowered by men.

hm142.ar: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ, لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ, لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَوَاتِ وَرَبُّ الْأَرْضِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ
hm142.tr: There is none worthy of worship but Allah the Mighty, the Forbearing. There is none worthy of worship but Allah, Lord of the Magnificent Throne. There is none worthy of worship but Allah, Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, and Lord of the Noble Throne.

hm143.ar: اللَّهُمَّ رَحْمَتَكَ أَرْجُو, فَلاَ تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ, وَأَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ, لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
hm143.tr: O Allah, I hope for Your mercy. Do not leave me to myself even for the blinking of an eye. Correct all of my affairs for me. There is none worthy of worship but You.

hm144.ar: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظّالِمِينَ
hm144.tr: There is none worthy of worship but You, glory is to You. Surely, I was among the wrong doers.

hm145.ar: اللَّهُ اللَّهُ رَبِّي لاَ أُشْرِكُ بِهِ شَيْئاً
hm145.tr: Allah, Allah is my Lord. I do not associate anything with Him.

hm174.ar: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ, اللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي, وَأَخْلِفْ لِي خَيْرَاً مِنْهَا
hm174.tr: We are from Allah and unto Him we return. O Allah take me out of my plight and bring to me after it something better.
hm174.tl: inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un. allahumma'jurni fi musibati wa akhlif li khayran minha

hm159.ar: اللَّهُمَّ لاَ سَهْلَ إِلاَّ مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلاً, وَأَنْتَ تَجْعَلُ الْحَزْنَ إِذَا شِئْتَ سَهْلاً
hm159.tr: O Allah, there is no ease other than what You make easy. If You please You ease sorrow.
hm159.r: Ibn Hibban (Hadith no. 2427), Ibn As- Sunni (Hadith no. 351)
hm159.s: Ibn Hibban (Hadith no. 2427), Ibn As- Sunni (Hadith no. 351).
hm159.tl: allahumma la sahla illa ma ja'altahu sahla, wa anta taj'alul-hazna idha shi'ta sahla

hm156.ar: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلاَلِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ, وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكِ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
hm156.tr: O Allah, suffice me with what You have allowed instead of what You have forbidden, and make me independent of all others besides You.
hm156.tl: allahummakfini bi halalika 'an haramik, wa aghnini bi fadlika 'amman siwak

hm164.tr: It is the Decree of Allah and He does whatever He wills.
hm164.v: The strong believer is better and more dear to Allah than the weak believer, and in each of them there is good. Be vigilant for what is to your benefit and seek the help of Allah and do not falter. But when you are stricken by some setback, do not say: "If only I had done such and such..." rather say: "It is the Decree of Allah and He does whatever He wills". For verily the saying 'if...' begins the work of the Devil.
hm164.ta: الدُّعَاءُ حِينَمَا يَقَعُ مَا لاَ يَرْضَاهُ أَوْ غُلِبَ عَلَى أَمْرِهِ

fd15.ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
fd15.tr: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah. There is no might nor power except with Allah.
fd15.tl: bismillah, tawakkaltu 'alallah, la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
fd15.v: Whoever recites this supplication, it will be said to him: "You will be guided, sufficed, and protected." Satan will then depart from him. Another satan will say: "How can you harm someone who has been guided, sufficed, and protected?!"

fd16.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّى أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَضِلَّ أَوْ أُضَلَّ أَوْ أَزِلَّ أَوْ أُزَلَّ أَوْ أَظْلِمَ أَوْ أُظْلَمَ أَوْ أَجْهَلَ أَوْ يُجْهَلَ عَلَىَّ
fd16.tr: O Allah, I seek refuge in You lest I should stray or be led astray, slip or be tripped, wrong or be wronged, or act foolishly or have foolishness done to me.
fd16.tl: allahumma inni a'udhu bika an adilla aw udalla, aw azilla aw uzalla, aw adhlima aw udhlama, aw ajhala aw yujhala 'alayya
fd16.v: When a person leaves the house, they will encounter all kinds of things, both good and bad, especially harm caused by themselves. Therefore, it is commanded to seek refuge from oneself and from others.
fd16.r: Abu Dawud, at-Tirmidzi, Ibn Majah · an-Nasa'i
fd16.s: HR. Abu Dawud, at-Tirmidzi, Ibn Majah and an-Nasa'i

hm18.ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا, وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا, وَعَلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا
hm18.tr: In the Name of Allah we enter, in the Name of Allah we leave, and upon our Lord we depend.
